name: Prisma Veritux
tradeable: unranked only, no Forma or Catalyst

groups.activity: crack Void Relics, trade Prime parts for Ducats
groups.mode: squad of four for more reward picks

rows.label: Ducats
rows.note: trade Prime parts and blueprints at any Relay Ducat Kiosk except Maroo's Bazaar

rows.label: Prisma Veritux
rows.note: arrives built and ready to equip; no Foundry step
rows.alt: or a TennoCon relay visit with Baro's Relay Ticket

conditions: Baro's stock changes every visit; the Prisma Veritux isn't guaranteed even when he is. Check any Ducat Kiosk countdown to see which relay he's visiting.
MR 8 is needed to equip it, and to receive it in a trade.

disclosures.title: leveling it for Mastery
disclosures.body: Archmelee leveling, not the purchase, is what people call the real work. Salacia (Neptune, Archwing Mobile Defense) is the near-unanimous spot: 3-4 solo runs with no booster, fewer with an affinity booster or a friend nuking spawns on Elytron while you sit safe on Amesha.
